The first live FTMO position (2026-11-11 ~09:45Z): equity 99,627.86, floating -38.52, as
reports/FTMO_ACCOUNT_STATE.json would publish it, plus the executor's SENT intent that licensed it.
Equity, floating P&L and time are the measured ones. Symbol, side, lot, prices and the sleeve are
ILLUSTRATIVE (the box's intents ledger is not in the repository): the fixture tests the join, not
the identity of the first trade.
